summary: Banco Macro S.A., the Argentine bank whose ADRs are registered as Macro Bank Inc. (6-K filed Nov 5, 2026), disclosed to the CNV, BYMA and A3 Mercados that it repurchased 685,000 own Class B common shares (Ps$1 par, one vote each) at an average Ps$9,735.013 per share, for an aggregate Ps$6,668,484,135, under Section 64 of Argentine Law 26,831 and applicable CNV rules — the local equivalent of a US issuer share buyback rather than a tender offer. No board recommendation, advisor, premium or close date stated; buyback mechanics govern pacing and volume limits. Watch for continued repurchase disclosures and their effect on float and per-share metrics.
